pages.text:
Conduits move things between machines: FE, items, liquids, gases and heat. Conduits of the same kind join into one network; mixed tiers run at the slowest tier's speed.
Next to a machine, a conduit connects on its own, following the machine's side settings.
# The Wrench
Shift + mouse wheel changes its mode (the colour of its grip):
- Configure: right-click a conduit side to cycle Auto, Input, Output and Disabled (sneak: backward), or the joint between two conduits to split or join them. Right-click a multiblock to check it.
- Rotate: right-click a machine to turn it (sneak: the other way).
- Port: multiblock ports and machine faces (next page).
- Dismantle: sneak-right-click a machine to pick it up with its contents, or a conduit or a block of a multiblock. Dismantle on a filtered connection removes the filter first.

# Multiblock ports
Multiblocks do IO only through their ports: blocks on the outside of the structure set to a mode, marked with a plate (a blue ring takes in, an orange one gives out). A new structure gets a few in the middle of its sides.
With the Wrench in Port mode, right-click a block's face to see its port, and sneak-right-click to cycle it through the modes that structure allows. Each outer face of a block is its own port, so one corner can take things in on one side and give them out on another. Ports stay where you set them, even if the block is broken and put back. The Ports tab in the structure's GUI lists them.
On a single machine, Port mode shows and cycles the clicked face instead.
